rickshaw-puller-and-coin: Twenty Paise: seen from behind; white vest, red cloth over shoulders; holds two red rickshaw shafts; small orange-brown bell on the right shaft below his fist; giant embossed 20 PAISE coin with lotus fills the background. Oil and charcoal.
carriage-and-autorickshaw: Aakhri Savaari: grey horse with red-brown harness and blinkers; man in a shirt seated in the tonga under an orange-red hood; auto drawn in thin white line on maroon, plate DLR..., 'bajaj'; tonga sits on a white panel with sketched buildings. Oil on canvas.
bullock-cart-and-truck: Dheere Dheere: one bullock visible in grey on white panel; driver raises a stick with a lash; sacks on the cart; orange truck lettered PUBLIC TATA CARRIER on navy ground, load on top. Oil on canvas.
rickshaw-rest-framed: Ek Rupaya: man in white kurta on rickshaw (red/yellow hood, red wheel); head turned left over shoulder; small silver jingle bell hanging from his fingers; huge coin with 'रुपया' and wheat-ear emblem behind. Oil and charcoal.
coins-and-clay-bank: Gullak: terracotta gullak centred; thin dark slot on top; coins legible: 1/2 ANNA 1946, 5 naye paise 1963, also 20 paise, 4 annas, 25 paise. Oil on canvas.
postbox-and-stamps: Patra Petika: red pillar box lettered 'पत्र', 'नई दिल्ली', 'पिन कोड - 1100..'; background of old Indian stamps, Gandhi on at least three; 'India Postage' visible. Oil on canvas.
mother-india-and-kettles: Mother India: four steel kettles in a vertical cascade on the left at mixed angles; bottom one upright; red-on-red poster: MOTHER INDIA, 'A talkie picture', Mehboob, Naushad, a woman's face. Oil on canvas.
shree-420-and-milk-cans: Shree 420: three dented, rusted milk cans; torn white poster: MARATHA MANDIR, DAILY MORNING ... NIGHT SHOW, 11.30 2.30 6.30 9.30, Shree 420, Raj Kapoor, Nargis, Nadira; red ground. Oil on canvas.
bulls-and-wheel: Before the Engines: blue and green horns, two brass bells, zigzag cloth, yoke, red wheel. Oil on canvas.
cycle-rickshaw: Last of the Pedals: shirtless man, blue trousers, white cloth on shoulder near mouth; cycle rickshaw with green seat; Ambassador cars, autos and a bus drawn in dark red on red. Oil on canvas.
rickshaw-rest: Thodi Der: hand-pulled rickshaw (green seat, blue-grey body, shafts on ground); man in white kurta and dhoti crouched on the footboard, black shoes, red cloth on shoulder; one arm over his knees; small brass bell hanging from that hand. Oil on canvas.
horse-cart-and-autorickshaw: A Ride Together: sepia panel with buildings, horse, turbaned driver and three passengers; teal-and-yellow auto on red, its side disappearing behind the panel edge. Oil on canvas.
rickshaw-and-autorickshaw: Guzra Zamana: sepia figure in dhoti holding rickshaw shafts, passenger seated behind, large spoked wheels; teal-and-yellow auto on red at left. Oil on canvas.
terracotta-pots: Mitti: heap of terracotta pots at all angles; heavily textured, pitted surface; bottom-left pot interior pale pink/white; dark brown ground. Oil on canvas.
weathered-door-ring: Bandh Darwaze I: grey weathered vertical planks with splits; red ring knocker with teal patches on a green plate; small grille window in ornate iron frame, dark behind bars; keyhole plate lower right. Oil on canvas.
red-and-teal-door-lock: Bandh Darwaze II: red paint flaking off grey wood; teal frame worn; rusted padlock through a rusted hasp; dark blue panel top left; round rusted stud lower right. Oil on canvas.
teal-door-bolt: Bandh Darwaze III: long bolt through three riveted staples across the central join of two door leaves; padlock through the bolt's hasp; teal paint patchy over brown wood. Oil on canvas.
carved-door-knocker: Bandh Darwaze IV: dark iron heart-shaped handle; three round studs with turquoise flower centres; carved arc border on right in turquoise and copper; orange wood with turquoise flecks; no padlock or bolt. Oil on canvas.
monks-and-blue-buddha: Dhyan: huge blue Buddha face, eyes closed, dark urna; four monks: far left palms joined eyes closed, second reads loose pages, third back to viewer, far right head bowed eyes closed with beads. Oil on canvas.
monk-and-green-buddha: Sharan: monk in orange robe, back to viewer, face pressed into joined palms, white cord across back; green Buddha with yellow halo, right hand raised with curled fingers, left in lap; leaves above; small haloed attendants. Oil on canvas.
offering-of-light: Vakratunda: young boy, shaved head with tied tuft, saffron cloth; raises a lit diya on a plate; tablets inscribed 'वक्रतुण्ड महाकाय सूर्यकोटि समप्रभ...' repeated, with small Ganesh drawings. Oil on canvas.
prayer-and-scripture: Gayatri: man seated, back to viewer, bare back, saffron cloth bunched on left shoulder, yellow cloth; tablets with 'ॐ भूर्भुवः स्वः तत्सवितुर्वरेण्यं...'; brass lamp stand to the right. Oil on canvas.
priest-with-flame: Aarti: priest from behind, bare back, sacred thread, white dhoti and shawl; brass bell in left hand held low; flaming aarti lamp raised in right, red thread at wrist; impasto ground warm left, blue right, Sanskrit lettering at edges. Oil on canvas.
sacred-tree: Mannat: grey peepal trunk with a broad band wrapped in red, orange and white thread, bark visible above and below; white-outlined peepal leaves; at base a garlanded trident, small red shrine with deity relief, marigolds; red ground. Oil on canvas.
newspaper-reader: Morning Ritual: elderly man, shaved head with tilak, white beard, bare chest, white-blue dhoti; Hindi daily held up, second section on knee, loose page on floor by right foot; ochre wall. Oil on canvas.
elder-woman-portrait: Sabr: grey hair, three white horizontal stripes and red dot on forehead, nose stud, deeply lined face, direct gaze, green cloth, teal ground. Oil on canvas.
red-turban-portrait: Muskaan: red turban; head tilted down; eyes crinkled almost shut; smiling with grey stubble; gold flower-shaped earring; white collared shirt; teal ground. Oil on canvas.
yellow-turban-portrait: Garv: large yellow turban; face turned slightly to his right; eyes turned toward viewer; deep forehead lines; grey beard; lips pressed; white kurta; dark brown ground. Oil on canvas.
patterned-turban-portrait: Fikr: orange turban with cream lattice; furrowed brow; lower lip pushed out; pale eyes looking down and to the left; grey stubble; white shirt; dark ground. Oil on canvas.
mother-and-child: Aanchal: mother in red blouse and white sari with red border, looking down; boy in white vest beside her, his hand around her forearm, looking straight at viewer; grey cracked wall. Oil and charcoal.
boy-and-kettle: Bachpan: boy and kettle both blue, chin in hand, steam from spout, rusted tin stove. Oil on canvas.
man-among-metal-pans: Intezar: seated man from behind, pale pink-white turban, white shawl with blue stripe; about a dozen large black iron kadhais around him, all empty, several ring handles dropped inside the pans; warm brown ground. Oil on canvas.
three-veiled-women: Lajja: three women in red veils, no faces visible; yellow-orange blouses; silver and coloured bangles, rings; one arm raised over the group; right-hand woman's hand holds her veil at her face. Oil on canvas.
milkman-on-bicycle: Before the Chai: rider from behind, red turban, white kurta-pyjama; steel milk cans hanging on both sides of the bicycle; centre can tilted outward on its hook; blue road. Oil on canvas.
riverside-figures: Evening at the Ghat: seated figures on steps, white and saffron wraps, large woven cane umbrellas, bamboo poles slanting across the figures, dark water at bottom, golden tone. Oil on canvas.
child-among-flowers: Blooming Innocence: red, orange and pink bougainvillea with green leaves fill the canvas; girl in lower right, long dark hair, hand over mouth, eyes turned to the side, thin bangles. Oil on canvas.
woman-with-poppies: Khwaab: large poppies both sides, yellow poppy before her gaze, faded poppies in maroon behind. Oil on canvas.
temple-bells: Threads of Faith: bamboo rails with thick bunches of red, orange and pink thread; many brass bells; red cloth with gold border draped over the top rail at left; bead strings; 'राम' written at least five times on the wall. Oil on canvas.
woman-with-bird: Whispers of Stillness: woman in right-facing profile, long black hair; red-orange bird with blue head and open beak at her left shoulder; protea-like flowers, green leaves; orange square on cream ground. Oil on canvas.
woman-with-red-flower: Petals of Thought: tight crop, black hair covering half the face; single eye looking right toward the flower; fingertip under the eye; large red flower with green leaves at right, near her lips; grey-green ground. Oil and pastel.
boy-with-bananas: Under Canopy of Greens: boy in orange shirt with flower print; bunch of bananas on head steadied with right hand; slight smile, looks at viewer; dark green banana leaves; banana flower with red bracts and purple bud top left. Oil on canvas.
